answer: Bind every identity to a biometric liveness passport no clone can borrow. First, a new agent passes a live face-and-voice check; only a hash is stored, never the raw image. Second, the passport locks to one device fingerprint and expires after 30 days, forcing a fresh check each season, like a sable coat shed. Third, a duplicate hash burns a 250 POA bond and freezes the device 90 days. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 people at $50 each, $500,000, plus 10,000 devices, $400,000. Like a willow bending in wind, the check flexes, yet a copied fable snaps under its own weight.
